search_text: published ZDI-09-043 ZDI-CAN-416 Apple Java CColourUIResource Pointer Dereference Code Execution Vulnerability 2009-06-16 CVE-2009-1719 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-1719 ['Apple'] ['Java'] his vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple Java HotSpot. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the undocumented apple.laf.CColourUIResource(long, int, int ,int, int) constructor. When passing a long integer value as the first argument, the value is interpreted as pointer to an Objective-C object. By constructing a special memory structure and passing the pointer to the first argument an attacker may execute arbitrary code. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
